name: Mathredis Firestar
summary: At Flame Crest, Mathredis Firestar binds Lesser Arcanums in the Burning Steppes. He relies on his dead mentor’s research and the energy released by each binding.

sections.title: A Master's Legacy and Magic Addiction
sections.body:
At Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes, Mathredis Firestar crafts Lesser Arcanums from his mentor Telmius Dreamseeker’s work. Telmius died in Dire Maul’s ancient ruins while seeking magical secrets from the Shen'dralar. He invented the bindings, but Mathredis cannot yet make the greatest arcanums. So he turns to lesser ones.

His craft is more than study. Like other blood elves since the Sunwell fell, Mathredis hungers for arcane power. Binding materials to ancient librams releases violent magical discharges. He draws on that energy to sustain himself.

sections.title: The Art of the Arcanum
sections.body:
Mathredis accepts the proper tomes, including the Librams of Constitution, Resilience, Rumination, Tenacity, or Voracity, along with rare reagents. He binds the volatile reagents to the text and concentrates their essence into an arcanum. The finished arcanum permanently enchants headwear or leg armor.

When adventurers bring the components, Mathredis trades his craft for payment and the arcane sustenance he craves.

faq.answer: Mathredis Firestar is a blood elf mage at Flame Crest, a neutral outpost in the Burning Steppes. He can forge Lesser Arcanums to enchant armor.
Since the Sunwell was destroyed, blood elves have suffered severe magical withdrawal. Mathredis draws on the residual energy released as he creates and binds arcanums to ease his addiction.
Telmius Dreamseeker was Mathredis's late master and the inventor of arcanums. He went to Dire Maul to seek knowledge from the Shen'dralar, but died there before passing on all his expertise.

faq.q: What kinds of arcanums can Mathredis make?
faq.answer: Mathredis can forge Lesser Arcanums of Constitution, Resilience, Rumination, Tenacity, and Voracity. His master's most potent arcanums remain beyond his grasp.

angles.text: As a mage, you can recognize Mathredis's arcanum craft as a desperate, volatile way to draw raw magical nourishment from the binding process.
